items.title: BTSのジンを起用 グッチの新キャンペーン「Gucci Primavera」公開
items.summary: Gucci unveiled its FW26 'Primavera' campaign spotlighting the Demna-designed debut collection, featuring ten global personalities including BTS's Jin, Xiao Zhan, aespa's Ningning, Shawn Mendes, Rico Nasty, Alex Consani, with a Kate Moss short film directed by Johan Renck lip-syncing Chris Isaak. Photographer Michal Chelbin styled portraits after Renaissance/Botticelli aesthetics.

items.title: 「グッチ」が新広告キャンペーン“グッチ ラ ファミリア“を発表
items.summary: WWD Japan's trade coverage of Gucci's new global ad campaign under Demna, detailing the ambassador roster and positioning the campaign as reinforcing brand heritage with a contemporary identity following the creative director's first runway show.

items.title: 'Sold-out King' BTS Jin, Gucci Campaign Jacket to Chicago Concert T-Shirt: Sold Out Again
items.summary: Reports that the jacket BTS's Jin wore in Gucci's Primavera campaign sold out within 24 hours of release, coinciding with sold-out concert merchandise in Chicago; frames Jin's ambassador role as generating outsized commercial pull for Gucci despite no official sales figures disclosed.

items.title: [theqoo] BTS JIN X GUCCI PRIMAVERA CAMPAIGN PHOTOSHOOT
items.summary: Korean community thread reacting to Jin's Gucci Primavera photoshoot skews mixed-to-critical: many commenters called the smokey-eye makeup and posing awkward or disappointing for someone known as a natural beauty, while a minority liked the debut-era throwback aesthetic and praised his willingness to experiment.

items.title: BTS Member Gets Brutally Trolled Over New Look
items.summary: Aggregates harsher social-media backlash to Jin's edgy Gucci Primavera styling (grey biker jacket, dark denim, heavy eyeliner), quoting critics who called it boring and questioned whether his 'worldwide handsome' image still held; illustrates the divisive, not uniformly positive, fan reaction to the campaign.

items.title: 肖战宁艺卓金硕珍 Gucci 新地广
items.summary: Weibo fan-post aggregation celebrating new Gucci outdoor billboard ads featuring Xiao Zhan (his 8th Gucci campaign across five years), Ning Yizuo and Jin Suk-jin (BTS Jin); largely fan-enthusiasm content ('everyone looks handsome and beautiful') rather than independent commentary, indicating high fandom buzz volume but low critical depth.

items.title: "84곳 문 닫았다"…매장 줄이는 명품 브랜드의 속내
items.summary: Kering closed 84 stores group-wide in H1 2026 (targeting 100 for the year, up from 75 in 2025), about 5% of directly operated locations, with Gucci a major share of closures. Gucci's sales decline narrowed from -8% in Q1 to -2% in Q2; industry is shifting from multi-store expansion to flagship-only 'selection and concentration' strategy as e-commerce reduces need for transaction-focused stores.

items.title: 肖战宁艺卓 Gucci新地广 亚洲女星0-1突破
items.summary: Coverage of the FW26 global campaign noting Ning Yizuo became the first Asian woman to appear in a Gucci seasonal ready-to-wear ad; flags industry skepticism about whether the compressed under-4-month ambassador-to-campaign turnaround (versus a traditional 2-3 year vetting cycle) is a sustainable brand practice.

items.title: 2026最不保值奢侈品排行：完整贬值数据与回收行情
items.summary: Chinese secondhand-market analysis ranking Gucci among the weakest resale-value luxury brands for 2026, citing Gucci Jackie recovery prices at only 30-50% of retail versus far higher retention for Hermes/Chanel; notes seasonal/print/colorway pieces hold especially poor resale value and resellers often quote high online then bargain down in-store.

items.title: 不振のグッチ｢日本だけが好調｣その"カラクリ"
items.summary: Analysis explaining why Gucci's Japan sales have outperformed other regions even amid repeated price hikes, contrasting with continued weakness across other Gucci markets including mainland China; frames Japan as an outlier propping up otherwise soft group results.

items.title: 연말 시즌 앞두고 명품 가격 'N차 인상'···"한국만 배짱장사" 비판 확산
items.summary: Reports renewed year-end price hikes across luxury brands including Gucci in Korea, amplifying consumer criticism that brands practice region-specific overpricing ('한국만 배짱장사'); cites EU antitrust fines against Gucci, Chloe and Loewe over resale-price-maintenance practices as context for pricing-power scrutiny.

items.title: 명품 갤러리 - 구찌 관련 스레드
items.summary: Korean luxury-goods community board (DCInside) discussion thread touching on Gucci among other brands, including replica/counterfeit chatter and general skepticism toward brand value common on this board; indicative of the lower-tier, informal community sentiment channel rather than a single focused controversy.
